blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Automated quality assessment of rehabilitation exercises relies heavily on accurate human pose estimation from video data. Although numerous RGB-based pose estimation methods have been proposed, the impact of camera placement on detecting clinically relevant movement errors remains insufficiently explored. To address this gap, we introduce REHAB26-ViewAngles, a dataset comprising correct and incorrect rehabilitation exercise executions captured from a wide range of camera angles. Furthermore, we propose a novel separability metric to quantify an algorithm’s ability to distinguish between valid and faulty exercise repetitions. Using these tools, we analyze how various RGB-based pose-estimation strategies are suitable for exercise quality assessment under varying camera placements. In particular, we analyze single-camera 2D and 3D pose estimation and four multi-camera strategies: a combination of two orthogonal 2D views, 3D triangulation, weighted 3D fusion, and an AI-based pose-estimation transformer model specifically trained from two synchronized cameras. Our findings reveal that an optimally placed 2D camera can improve the separability by 16.9 % over the commonly used 0 ∘ 0^{\circ} frontal view and frequently outperforms single-camera 3D estimation, while combining two views can further improve accuracy by up to 13.1 %. These results offer practical guidance for deploying rehabilitation monitoring in both home and clinical settings.
blocks.zh: 对康复工作进行自动化质量评估,在很大程度上依赖于从视频数据中准确的人体姿势估计。 虽然提出了许多基于RGB的布局估计方法,但相机布置对发现临床相关运动误差的影响仍未得到充分探讨。 为了弥补这一差距,我们引进了REHAB26-ViewAngles,这是一个数据集,包含从广泛镜头角度记录的正确和不正确的康复活动处决。 此外,我们提出了一个新的可分离性指标,以量化一个算法区分有效重复和错误重复的能力。 使用这些工具,我们分析各种基于RGB的姿势估计策略如何适合在不同的相机布置下进行演练质量评估. 特别是,我们分析单相机2D和3D的配置估计和4个多相机策略:结合两个正交2D视图,3D三角,加权3D聚变,以及一个由两个同步相机专门训练的基于AI的姿势估计变压器模型. 我们的发现显示,最优置放的2D相机可以比常用的0 0^{\0^{\circ}前视提高16.9%的可分离性,并且经常超过单相机3D的估计,同时结合两种观点可以进一步提高准确性,最高可达13.1%. 这些结果为在家庭和临床环境中进行康复监测提供了实际指导。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The demand for physiotherapy and rehabilitation is steadily increasing, driven by aging populations and the rising prevalence of musculoskeletal disorders ( Gimigliano et al., 2017 ) . At the same time, a shortage of trained physical therapists has accelerated the transition toward home-based and minimally supervised rehabilitation. In such settings, patient improvements depend not only on whether exercises are performed, but also on how accurately they are executed, as even small deviations or compensatory movements can reduce therapeutic effectiveness ( Argent et al., 2018 ; Zhang et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 由于人口老化和肌肉骨骼疾病发病率上升(Gimigliano等人,2017年),对理疗和康复的需求稳步增加。 同时,由于缺少训练有素的物理治疗师,加快了向以家庭为基础、受最低监督的康复过渡。 在这种情况下,病人的改善不仅取决于是否进行锻炼,也取决于其执行的准确性,因为即使是小的偏差或补偿性运动也会降低疗效(Argent等人,2018年;Zhang等人,2022年)。

blocks.en: Recent advances in AI-driven computer vision enable new forms of rehabilitation support outside traditional clinical environments, particularly in home-based and minimally supervised settings ( Bonato et al., 2024 ; Park et al., 2022 ) . Modern pose estimation methods ( Dubey and Dixit, 2023 ; Sardari et al., 2023 ; Jocher et al., 2026 ; Nogueira et al., 2025 ) can extract skeletal representations from standard RGB video in real time on consumer smartphones, providing positions of joints in either 2D (measured in pixels of video) or estimated 3D (measured in virtual meters) space. Such skeleton data can be used to evaluate rehabilitation correctness, measure progress, and provide general guidance for patients during home rehabilitation.
blocks.zh: 人工智能驱动的计算机视觉最近的进展使得在传统临床环境之外,特别是在以家庭为基础和受最低监管的环境中,能够提供新的康复支助(Bonato等人,2024年;Park等人,2022年)。 现代的推算方法(Dubey and Dixit, 2023年;Sardari等人, 2023年;Jocher等人, 2026年;Nogueira等人, 2025年)可以从消费者智能手机上实时提取标准RGB视频中的骨骼表示,提供2D(以视频像素测量)或估计3D(以虚拟米测量)空间中的关节位置. 这种骨架数据可用于评估康复正确性,衡量进度,并为家庭康复期间的患者提供一般指导.

blocks.en: Skeleton-based analysis of movement correctness has gained increasing attention across a variety of application domains, including sports training and fitness exercise ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) . In these settings, user’s movements are typically represented as skeletal joint sequences and evaluated against a pre-trained model of the target exercise. However, physical rehabilitation presents additional challenges, as safe and effective therapy must account for each patient’s individual capabilities, limitations, and recovery progress. Consequently, universal motion models are generally insufficient for rehabilitation monitoring, necessitating the use of personalized models that capture patient-specific movement patterns.
blocks.zh: 基于Skeleton的动作正确性分析在包括体育训练和健身锻炼在内的各种应用领域得到了越来越多的关注(周等人,2026年). 在这些环境中,用户的移动通常以骨骼联动序列表示,并参照经过预先训练的目标演练模式进行评估。 然而,身体康复带来了更多的挑战,因为安全有效的治疗必须考虑到每个病人的个人能力、局限性和康复进展。 因此,普遍运动模型一般不足以进行康复监测,因此有必要使用个人化模型,以了解患者特定的运动模式。

blocks.en: 1.1 Personalized Rehabilitation Monitoring
blocks.zh: 1.1 个性化康复监测

blocks.en: In a real-world rehabilitation scenario, we cannot expect to collect many examples of correct and incorrect exercise execution that would be necessary for training a personalized neural-network (NN) model. Instead, recent personalized AI-based rehabilitation monitoring systems employ similarity-based analysis using a few examples of patient’s exercise collected during supervised patient’s sessions with a therapist. In this work, we adopt the exercise monitoring pipeline proposed in ( Jánošová et al., 2026a ) , which is illustrated in Fig. 1 .
blocks.zh: 在现实世界的康复情况下,我们不能指望收集许多正确和不正确的锻炼执行的例子,这对于培训个性化神经网络模型是必要的。 相反,最近基于人工智能的个性化康复监测系统采用了类似的分析方法,利用在受监督的病人与治疗师的诊疗期间收集的几个病人运动实例。 在这项工作中,我们采用了(Jánošová等人,2026a)中提议的监测程序,图1说明了这一点。

blocks.en: Figure 1: High-level scheme of personalized monitoring of rehabilitation exercises. The highlighted red parts are the main focus of this paper – we are especially interested in the optimal positioning of camera(s) to capture the patient’s movements.
blocks.zh: 图1:康复活动个人化监测高级计划。 这些突出的红色部分是本文的主要焦点 — — 我们特别关心摄影机的最佳定位,以捕捉患者的动作.

blocks.en:
The pipeline assumes that the patient first visits the physiotherapist (PT), who determines suitable exercise types and teaches the patient how to perform them correctly, taking into account their current needs and abilities. During the practice, the PT records several exercise repetitions using a mobile application and provides a simple evaluation of whether the patient performed them according to instructions. From these examples, the personalized model of correct exercising is created.
As illustrated in Fig. 1 , both PT-guided and home exercises are processed through the same computational pipeline, which includes video recording, skeletal pose estimation, automatic segmentation into individual repetitions, and extraction of interpretable features that describe relationships between body segments. Correctly performed repetitions identified by the physiotherapist are used to (1) estimate personalized confidence intervals that capture acceptable variation in individual feature values over time, and to (2) select a single repetition as a personalized reference .
blocks.zh:
输油管假定病人首先去看物理治疗师,他根据病人当前的需要和能力,确定合适的运动类型并教病人如何正确进行。 在练习期间,PT记录了使用移动应用程序的几次练习重复,并提供了患者是否按照指示执行的简单评价. 从这些例子中,产生了正确锻炼的个性化模型.
如图1所示,PT制导和家用练习都通过同一计算管道进行,包括录像、骨骼估计、自动分解为个别重复,以及提取描述身体各段之间关系的可解释特征。 物理治疗师查明的正确重复用于:(1) 估计个人化的置信间隔,该间隔可捕捉不同特征值随时间而变化的可接受性,(2) 选择一次重复作为个性化的参考。

blocks.en: During home exercise, each repetition is temporally aligned with the reference and evaluated by similarity analysis , which compares the feature values in individual frames to their respective confidence intervals. Feature weighting based on discriminative importance further enables the computation of an overall quality score and the identification of the most relevant movement errors ( Jánošová et al., 2024 ) . A more detailed explanation of the exercise quality analysis will be provided in Section 4.1 .
blocks.zh: 在家庭运动期间,每次重复的时间都与参考一致,并通过相似性分析加以评价,该分析将单个框中的特征值与各自的置信间隔进行比较。 基于歧视性重要性的特征权重进一步有助于计算总体质量分数和确定最相关的移动错误(Jánošová等人,2024年)。 第4.1节将对工作质量分析作出更详细的解释。

blocks.en: 1.2 Patient Orientation Challenge
blocks.zh: 1.2 患者定向挑战

blocks.en: Accurate assessment of rehabilitation exercises depends strongly on the quality of skeleton data, which in turn depends on camera placement. Unlike the dynamic, full-body movements commonly studied in SOTA pose estimation research, physiotherapy exercises typically involve slow, controlled motions with limited ranges of movement. In this context, pose estimation errors of only a few degrees may be clinically significant. Joint visibility and self-occlusion can change substantially across viewpoints, directly affecting the reliability of movement analysis.
blocks.zh: 对康复工作的准确评估在很大程度上取决于骨架数据的质量,而骨架数据又取决于照相机的放置。 与SOTA中通常研究的动态,全体运动形成估计研究不同,物理治疗练习通常涉及运动范围有限的缓慢,可控运动. 在这方面,提出只有几度的估计错误可能具有临床意义。 共同的能见度和自我包容可大大改变不同观点,直接影响到运动分析的可靠性。

blocks.en: Camera placement is further constrained by practical considerations. In home-based rehabilitation, patients typically rely on a single, uncalibrated camera, making viewpoint selection especially critical. However, if the expected gains in accuracy are substantial, the use of two smartphones to record exercises in both clinical and home settings may be feasible. The use of more than two cameras is considered unlikely.
blocks.zh: 相机的放置受到实际考虑的进一步制约. 在家庭式康复中,患者一般依靠单一的,不校准的相机,使得观点选择尤为关键. 然而,如果预期的准确性提高很大,则使用两台智能手机记录临床和家庭环境下的练习可能是可行的。 使用两个以上相机被认为是不太可能的.

blocks.en: In this paper, we study how camera viewpoint influences pose estimation and exercise-quality assessment in rehabilitation using similarity-based data analysis. We evaluate the effect of camera viewing angle for common physiotherapy exercises, focusing on real-world settings where personalized exercise models need to be constructed from limited training data. We evaluate single-camera configurations across a range of viewing angles, analyze robustness to small changes in patient orientation, and compare the suitability of 2D and 3D pose representations obtained from monocular pose estimation models. Furthermore, we explore several strategies for using multiple uncalibrated cameras, including a combination of two orthogonal 2D views, geometric triangulation, merging of independently estimated 3D skeleton sequences, and the cross-view transformer-based RUMPL framework ( Ghasemzadeh et al., 2026 ) trained on multi-view inputs.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们研究照相机观点如何影响利用基于相似性的数据分析,对康复进行估计和锻炼质量评估。 我们评价相机取景角度对常见物理治疗练习的影响,重点是需要从有限的培训数据中构建个性化运动模型的现实世界环境. 我们从一系列的视角来评价单相机配置,分析强性到患者定向的小变化,并比较2D和3D的合适性,从单相机姿势估计模型中获得的表示. 此外,我们探索使用多个未校准相机的几种策略,包括两个正交2D视图的组合,几何三角形,独立估计的3D骨架序列的合并,以及基于跨视变压器的RUMPL框架(Ghasemzadeh et al., 2026),多视输入训练.

blocks.en: The main contributions of this paper are as follows: • We design and collect a new dataset (REHAB26-ViewAngles) comprising typical rehabilitation exercises recorded from a wide range of angles. The dataset contains annotated examples of both correct and incorrect exercises and enables assessing the impact of a person’s orientation towards camera(s) on the quality of exercising. • We establish an automated evaluation methodology using personalized models of correct exercise execution, which are essential for clinically relevant monitoring. This methodology features a novel separability metric that quantifies an algorithm’s ability to distinguish between correct and incorrect repetitions. • We investigate 2D and 3D pose estimation strategies, including monocular, multi-view, and learning-based cross-view transformer (RUMPL) approaches, to obtain robust skeletal representations from RGB video. • We experimentally evaluate approaches to single- and multi-camera skeleton extraction over the new dataset. For selected SOTA pose estimation methods, we identify the optimum patient orientations.
blocks.zh: 本文件的主要贡献如下: 我们设计和收集新的数据集(REHAB26-ViewAngles),其中包括从广泛角度记录的典型的康复工作。 该数据集载有附加说明的正确和不正确练习的例子,并能够评估个人对镜头的定向对练习质量的影响。 我们采用个性化的正确演练执行模式,建立自动评价方法,这对临床监测至关重要。 这一方法有一个新的分离度量度,它量化了算法区分正确重复和不正确重复的能力。 我们调查2D和3D配置估计策略,包括单视、多视和基于学习的交叉视变器(RUMPL)方法,以便从RGB视频中获取强健的骨骼表现。 我们实验性地评估单镜头和多镜头骨架提取方法 以覆盖新的数据集。 对于选定的SOTA进行估计的方法,我们确定最佳的病人方向。

blocks.en: The remainder of this paper is organized as follows. Section 2 reviews the related work in pose estimation and skeleton-based rehabilitation monitoring. Section 3 introduces the proposed REHAB26-ViewAngles dataset. Section 4 explains the new separability measure, presents investigated approaches to skeleton extraction using single- and multi-camera setups, and formulates the research questions addressed in the experimental evaluation. Section 5 presents and discusses the experimental evaluation, resulting in practical recommendations for camera placement across different rehabilitation exercises. Finally, Section 6 concludes the paper and outlines directions for future work.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Reliable AI-based rehabilitation monitoring depends on several interconnected research areas. This section reviews recent advances in human pose estimation, skeleton-based exercise analysis, and studies addressing the impact of camera viewpoint on pose estimation and motion analysis. Together, these topics provide the foundation for the research questions investigated in this paper.
blocks.zh: 可靠的基于AI的康复监测取决于几个相互关联的研究领域. 本节审查人类姿势估计的最新进展、基于骨架的锻炼分析,以及研究照相机观点对姿势估计和运动分析的影响。 这些专题共同为本文调查的研究问题提供了基础。

blocks.en:
Pose Estimation Methods. Skeleton data are most often obtained from RGB video by applying human pose estimation (HPE) methods that extract joint locations from each video frame ( Debnath et al., 2022 ; Sardari et al., 2023 ) .
2D pose estimation aims to localize body joints in the image plane and serves as the foundation for many 3D approaches. Most monocular 3D pose estimation methods follow a 2D-to-3D paradigm, where 2D joint locations are detected and subsequently lifted to 3D space ( Akhter and Black, 2015 ; Ramakrishna et al., 2012 ) , though some approaches estimate 3D poses directly via volumetric heatmaps ( Pavlakos et al., 2017 ) . More recently, learning-based methods have improved 2D-to-3D regression using transformers ( Li et al., 2022 ; Tang et al., 2023 ) or graph-based models ( Liu et al., 2021 ; Zhao et al., 2022 ) to encode skeletal relationships. While these designs reduce depth ambiguity, they remain fundamentally constrained by the limitations of a single viewpoint, leading recent studies ( Sun et al., 2025 ; Černek et al., 2025 ) to suggest that 2D estimation often yields more accurate and stable joint localization overall.
On the other hand, the 2D skeleton is often deformed by the camera viewpoint and cannot reliably capture out-of-plane motion or joint angles ( Klein et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh:
Pose估计方法. 从RGB视频中获取Skeleton数据最多的是应用人类姿势估计(HPE)方法从每个视频帧中提取联合位置(Debnath等人,2022年;Sardari等人,2023年).
2D平面浮图估计旨在将图像平面中的机体关节定位,并作为许多3D方法的基础. 大多数单体的3D表示估计方法遵循2D到3D的范式,其中检测到2D联动位置,随后升至3D空间(Akhter and Black,2015年;Ramakrishna等人,2012年),尽管有些方法通过体积热图直接估计3D(Pavlakos等人,2017年)。 最近,基于学习的方法利用变压器(Li等人,2022年;Tang等人,2023年)或基于图表的模型(Liu等人,2021年;Zhao等人,2022年)改进了2D-3D回归,以编码骨骼关系. 虽然这些设计降低了深度的模糊性,但它们仍然受到单一观点的局限,导致最近的研究(Sun等人,2025年;Černek等人,2025年)表明,2D估计往往能产生更准确和稳定的整体联合本地化。
另一方面,2D骨架往往被镜头视角变形,无法可靠地捕获飞机外运动或联合角度(Klein等人,2023年).

blocks.en: Multi-view approaches address some of these limitations by exploiting synchronized camera feeds, either through geometric triangulation of 2D detections ( Hartley and Sturm, 1997 ) or by learning to fuse multi-view features directly in 3D space ( Tu et al., 2020 ; Zhang et al., 2021 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Chharia et al., 2025 ) . However, standard multi-view networks often rely on fixed camera configurations, limiting their adaptability in home environments. To address this, recent frameworks like RUMPL ( Ghasemzadeh et al., 2026 ) map 2D keypoints into 3D ray vectors, eliminating the dependency on rigid camera arrangements. While this formulation allows the system to adapt to random camera placements, the resulting 3D reconstruction still depends on valid camera calibration to orient the vectors. Consequently, the performance of such models remains largely unexamined for capturing the subtle clinical movements required for rehabilitation, especially when limited to sparse, two-camera arrays.
blocks.zh: 多视图方法通过利用同步摄像头的摄像头,或者通过2D探测器的几何三角测量(Hartley和Sturm,1997年),或者通过学习在3D空间直接将多视图特征融为一体(Tu等人,2020年;Zhang等人,2021年;Li等人,2025年;Chharia等人,2025年),来解决其中一些局限性。 然而,标准的多视图网络往往依赖于固定的相机配置,限制了其在家庭环境中的适应性. 为了解决这一问题,最近的框架如RUMPL(Ghasemzadeh等人,2026年)将2D键点映射到3D射线矢量中,消除了对刚性相机安排的依赖. 虽然这种配制使得系统能够适应随机相机的布置,但由此产生的3D重建仍然依赖于有效的相机校准来引导向量. 因此,这种模型的性能基本上仍未受到审查,无法捕捉到康复所需的微妙临床运动,特别是在仅限于稀少的两相机阵列的情况下。

blocks.en: Given the spatial and computational requirements of multi-camera systems, practical rehabilitation monitoring typically relies on off-the-shelf monocular pose estimation solutions, with MediaPipe Pose (MPP) ( Bazarevsky et al., 2020 ) being among the most widely adopted. Owing to its real-time performance and efficient deployment on consumer mobile devices ( Černek et al., 2025 ) , it is particularly well suited for home-based rehabilitation applications. MediaPipe Pose combines a BlazePose-based 2D pose detector with the GHUM body model ( Xu et al., 2020 ) to estimate both 2D and 3D skeletal poses directly from monocular RGB video, providing a favorable balance between accuracy, computational efficiency, and ease of deployment.
blocks.zh: 鉴于多相机系统的空间和计算要求,实际的康复监测通常依靠现成的单体形成估计解决方案,其中MediaPipe Pose(MPP)(Bazarevsky等人,2020年)是最广泛采用的。 由于其实时性能和在消费移动设备上的有效部署(Černek等人,2025年),它特别适合家庭康复应用。 媒体 Pose将基于BlazePose的2D型假象探测器与GHUM车体模型(Xu等人,2020年)结合,直接从单视的RGB视频中估算出2D和3D型假象,在准确度,计算效率,部署方便等方面提供了有利的平衡.

blocks.en: Exercise Correctness Analysis. In rehabilitation, the primary objective is to determine whether an exercise is performed correctly while identifying and explaining movement errors. At the same time, rehabilitation monitoring systems should be readily accessible to the general public, making solutions based on standard consumer devices particularly attractive. Although some approaches rely on wearable sensors ( Lu et al., 2020 ) , recent research has increasingly focused on vision-based methods that operate on monocular RGB video acquired using standard mobile devices. These methods typically employ human pose estimation followed by feature extraction to transform high-dimensional movement into clinically meaningful descriptors ( Williams et al., 2019 ) . Practical implementations have recently demonstrated that this entire extraction pipeline can operate in real time directly on consumer smartphones ( Jánošová et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh: 进行正确性分析。 在康复方面,主要目标是确定一项工作是否正确进行,同时查明和解释移动错误。 同时,康复监测系统应便于公众使用,使基于标准消费装置的解决办法特别具有吸引力。 虽然有些方法依赖于可穿戴感应器(Lu等人,2020年),但最近的研究越来越侧重于使用标准移动设备获取的单光摄像带操作的基于视觉的方法. 这些方法通常采用人类姿势估计,然后提取特征,将高维运动转化为临床上有意义的描述符(Williams等人,2019年)。 最近的实际实施表明,整个提炼管道可直接实时在消费智能手机上运行(Jánošová等人,2026年b)。

blocks.en: Inspired by advances in general human motion analysis, some approaches learn generic representations of correct exercise execution using deep neural networks ( He et al., 2024 ) . However, such models generally require large amounts of annotated training data and are therefore difficult to personalize for individual patients in practical rehabilitation settings. Consequently, recent personalized rehabilitation monitoring systems predominantly rely on interpretable kinematic features derived from skeletal pose sequences, such as joint angles, limb orientations, or relative joint positions over time ( McCay et al., 2021 ; Müller and Röder, 2006 ) . During assessment, the feature trajectories extracted from a patient’s exercise are compared with those of a personalized reference using temporal alignment and similarity measures such as Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) ( Pereira et al., 2024 ) . Recent work has further improved this framework by introducing individualized feature weighting, allowing clinically more relevant movement characteristics to have a greater influence on the overall assessment ( Jánošová et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 受一般人类运动分析进步的启发,一些方法通过深神经网络学习正确锻炼执行的通用表述(He等人,2024年). 然而,这种模式一般需要大量附加说明的培训数据,因此难以在实际康复环境中使个别病人个性化。 因此,最近的个性化康复监测系统主要依靠由骨骼姿势序列产生的可解释的动能特征,如关节角、肢体定向或一段时间内相对的关节位置(McCay等人,2021年;Müller和Röder,2006年)。 在评估期间,将从病人运动中提取的特征轨迹与个性化参考的轨迹进行比较,采用时间调整和类似措施,如动态时间定时(DTW)(Pereira等人,2024年)。 最近的工作通过引入个性化特征权重,使临床上更具相关性的运动特征对总体评估产生更大的影响,从而进一步改善了这一框架(Jánošová等人,2024年)。

blocks.en: Role of Camera Viewpoint. Compared with advances in human pose estimation and exercise quality assessment, the influence of camera viewpoint has received relatively little attention. Most existing rehabilitation monitoring systems assume a fixed camera placement, typically using a frontal or semi-profile view, without systematically evaluating whether alternative viewpoints provide more reliable movement information. However, camera viewpoint directly affects joint visibility, self-occlusion, and ultimately the accuracy of pose estimation. Consequently, the ability to detect clinically relevant movement errors also depends on the chosen viewpoint. For example, squat depth and knee alignment are more readily observed from lateral views, whereas frontal views better capture arm symmetry and shoulder positioning.
blocks.zh: 镜头查看点的作用 。 与人类姿势估计和进行质量评估的进展相比,相机视角的影响受到的关注相对较少。 现有的大多数康复监测系统都假定固定的照相机位置,通常使用前视或半前视,而没有系统地评估其他观点是否提供了更可靠的移动信息。 然而,相机视角直接影响到联合可见度,自我包容,并最终影响姿势估计的准确性. 因此,检测临床相关运动错误的能力也取决于所选择的观点。 例如,从横向角度看,蹲深度和膝盖对齐比较容易观察,而前视则更好地捕捉手臂对称和肩部定位.

blocks.en: Recent studies provide growing evidence that viewpoint substantially influences the quality of skeleton-based movement analysis. Klein et al. (2023) demonstrated that MediaPipe Pose produces markedly different joint angle estimates across camera viewpoints, with the largest errors occurring when the upper limbs are oriented toward the camera. Similarly, Baldinger et al. (2025) reported that posterior viewpoints yield more stable lower-limb measurements owing to reduced self-occlusion, while accurate shoulder estimation remains challenging regardless of viewpoint. Furthermore, Zöllner et al. (2025) showed that camera angle strongly affects joint visibility during dynamic exercises, where changes in body orientation introduce additional viewpoint variability.
blocks.zh: 最近的研究提供了越来越多的证据,表明观点对骨架运动分析的质量有重大影响。 克莱因等人. (2023年)证明MediaPipe Pose对相机视距产生明显不同的联合角度估计,当上肢面向相机时发生最大的错误. 同样,Baldinger等人(2025年)报告说,由于自闭症减少,后视率产生更稳定的低山测量值,而不论观点如何,准确的肩部估计仍然具有挑战性。 此外,Zöllner等人(2025年)表明,相机角度在动态演练期间会强烈影响联合可见度,其中机体导向的变化带来了额外的视角可变性.

blocks.en: Despite these findings, a comprehensive evaluation of viewpoint selection for rehabilitation monitoring is still lacking, largely because suitable datasets are unavailable. Existing datasets for both general human motion analysis ( Ionescu et al., 2014 ; Shahroudy et al., 2016 ; Mehta et al., 2017 ) and rehabilitation exercises ( Li et al., 2024 ; Capecci et al., 2019 ; Černek et al., 2024 ; Vakanski et al., 2018 ) are typically recorded from only a small number of predefined viewpoints, most commonly frontal, lateral, or semi-profile views. Consequently, they do not enable a systematic investigation of patient orientation or camera placement, motivating the creation of the REHAB26-ViewAngles dataset presented in this work.
blocks.zh: 尽管得出了这些结论,但仍然缺乏对康复监测观点选择的全面评价,主要原因是没有适当的数据集。 用于一般人类运动分析(Ionescu等人,2014年;Shahroudy等人,2016年;Mehta等人,2017年)和康复演练(Li等人,2024年;Capecci等人,2019年;Černek等人,2024年;Vakanski等人,2018年)的现有数据集通常只记录了少数预先确定的观点,最常见的是正面观点,横向观点,或半侧视角. 因此,它们无法系统地调查病人的取向或照相机的放置情况,从而促使建立这项工作中介绍的REHAB26-ViewAngles数据集。

blocks.en: To enable a systematic study of camera viewpoint in rehabilitation monitoring, we collected a new dataset, REHAB26-ViewAngles, specifically designed to evaluate the influence of patient orientation on pose estimation and exercise quality assessment. Unlike existing rehabilitation datasets, which primarily aim to benchmark exercise recognition or movement assessment from a small number of predefined viewpoints, REHAB26-ViewAngles was designed around several considerations motivated by practical home-based rehabilitation.
blocks.zh: 为了能够系统地研究康复监测中的摄像头观点,我们收集了一套新的数据集,即REHAB26-ViewAngles,专门用来评估病人定向对姿势估计的影响,并进行质量评估。 现有的康复数据集主要旨在从少数预先确定的观点对识别或行动评估进行基准评估,与此不同的是,REHAB26-ViewAngles的设计是围绕一些出于实际的居家康复的考虑而设计的。

blocks.en: First, rather than maximizing the number of exercise types, we selected a representative set of rehabilitation exercises covering the most common movement patterns, body regions, and directions of motion encountered in clinical practice. This design allows us to investigate viewpoint effects across diverse movement characteristics while keeping the dataset sufficiently controlled.
blocks.zh: 首先,我们没有尽量增加锻炼类型,而是选择了一套有代表性的康复练习,涵盖临床实践中遇到的最常见的运动模式,身体区域和运动方向. 这种设计使我们能够调查各种运动特性的视角效应,同时对数据集进行充分的控制。

blocks.en: Second, the dataset emphasizes viewpoint diversity. Each exercise was recorded from a dense set of viewing angles covering the frontal hemisphere, enabling a detailed analysis of how patient orientation affects pose estimation and subsequent movement assessment. In addition to the nominal recording angles, small orientation offsets were intentionally allowed to simulate realistic situations in which patients do not position themselves exactly as instructed before starting an exercise.
blocks.zh: 第二,数据集强调观点多样性。 每项运动都是从覆盖前半球的密集的观测角度记录的,从而能够详细分析患者定向如何影响估计和随后的运动评估。 除了名义记录角度外,还有意允许小方向抵消模拟病人在开始一项运动前没有按照指示准确定位的现实情况。

blocks.en: Third, each exercise was performed both correctly and with clinically relevant execution errors identified by experienced physiotherapists. This enables not only the evaluation of pose estimation accuracy, but also the assessment of whether different viewpoints allow clinically meaningful movement deviations to be reliably detected.
blocks.zh: 第三,每次演习都正确进行,经验丰富的理疗师也发现了与临床有关的执行错误。 这不仅可以评估姿势估计的准确性,还可以评估不同观点是否允许可靠地检测临床有意义的运动偏差。

blocks.en: Finally, the recording setup reflects the intended deployment scenario. All videos were captured simultaneously using identical consumer smartphones, allowing both single-camera and multi-camera evaluation under realistic conditions while eliminating hardware-induced variability. Simultaneous recordings further provide temporally synchronized multi-view sequences suitable for evaluating multi-camera pose estimation and skeleton fusion methods. To ensure precise frame alignment across devices, temporal synchronization was established visually by recording a digital timer displaying milliseconds on a tablet visible from all viewpoints.
blocks.zh: 最后,记录设置反映了预期的部署情况。 所有视频都同时使用相同的消费智能手机进行捕获,允许在现实条件下进行单相机和多相机的评价,同时消除硬件引起的变异. 同时录制进一步提供了时间同步的多景序列,适合评价多相机形成估计和骨架聚变方法. 为确保各设备之间精确的帧对齐,通过将一个显示毫秒的数字定时器记录在从所有角度可见的平板电脑上,实现了时间同步。

blocks.en: Rather than maximizing the number of exercise types, we intentionally selected a small yet representative set of movements exhibiting different kinematic properties. Together, the exercises cover both upper- and lower-body rehabilitation, involve motion in different anatomical planes, and require substantially different camera viewpoints for reliable observation. For example, shoulder abduction is most naturally observed from a frontal view, whereas shoulder extension and squat depth are better captured from lateral viewpoints. The visual and spatial characteristics of the selected exercises are illustrated in Fig. 3 .
blocks.zh: 我们没有尽量增加锻炼种类,而是有意选择一套具有不同运动特性的小型但有代表性的运动。 这些演习共同涵盖上体和下体的复健,涉及不同解剖平面中的运动,并且需要非常不同的相机视角来进行可靠的观测. 例如,从正面看,最自然地观察到肩部绑架,而从横向角度看,肩部延伸和蹲部深度则较好。 图3显示了选定练习的视觉和空间特征。

blocks.en: To support the evaluation of clinically meaningful exercise monitoring methods rather than pose estimation alone, each exercise was additionally performed with five common execution errors defined in collaboration with experienced physiotherapists (Table 1 ). Examples include knee valgus, excessive trunk flexion, and insufficient range of motion. Each error was associated with a dedicated interpretable feature derived from the skeletal representation, enabling the evaluation of whether different camera viewpoints preserve the information required for reliable error detection.
blocks.zh: 为了支持对临床上有意义的锻炼监测方法的评价,而不是仅仅提出估计,每次锻炼还附加了与有经验的理疗师合作确定的五个常见执行错误(表1)。 例子包括膝盖瓦砾、树干过度弹性和运动范围不足。 每个错误都与从骨骼表示中衍生出来的专用可解释特征有关,从而能够评价不同的相机视角是否保存了可靠错误检测所需的信息.

blocks.en: 3.2 Acquisition Protocol
blocks.zh: 3.2 采购协议

blocks.en: To record the exercise, we utilized three synchronized iPhone 16e smartphones (30 FPS, 12 MP, f / 1.6 f/1.6 ) positioned in a fixed horizontal arrangement, as illustrated in Fig. 2 . To capture viewpoint variability, participants performed exercise sets while systematically shifting their orientation using a large floor protractor. A patient-centric coordinate system was adopted, where ( 0 ∘ 0^{\circ} ) corresponds to a frontal view, positive angles denote rotations to the right, and negative angles rotations to the left. Participants initially faced Cam1 and subsequently rotated toward Cam3 in ( 10 ∘ 10^{\circ} ) increments between exercise sets. Cam1, Cam2, and Cam3 were placed at fixed relative positions of − 90 ∘ -90^{\circ} , − 45 ∘ -45^{\circ} , and 0 ∘ 0^{\circ} with respect to the participant facing Cam3. As illustrated in Fig. 2 , this protocol produces relative viewing angles spanning the frontal hemisphere, from a + 90 ∘ +90^{\circ} right profile to a − 90 ∘ -90^{\circ} left profile. An additional reference recording was acquired with participants directly facing Cam2. Several examples of exercise recorded from various angles are shown in Fig. 3 .

blocks.en: Five volunteers (two male and three female) with different body types and fitness levels participated in the data collection. For every exercise and nominal viewing angle, each participant performed five correct repetitions together with five repetitions containing predefined execution errors, one for each clinically relevant error type. To avoid recording multiple nearly identical repetitions, correct and incorrect executions were intentionally interleaved rather than grouped together. Our previous experience with rehabilitation data collection showed that consecutive correct repetitions tend to become unnaturally consistent, whereas alternating correct and incorrect executions introduces the natural variability observed during home exercise. All recordings were manually segmented into individual repetitions and annotated by the supervising physiotherapist.
blocks.zh: 5名身体类型和健身水平不同的志愿者(两名男性和三名女性)参加了数据收集。 每一次练习和名义观看角度,每个参与者都进行了五次正确的重复,同时进行了五次包含预先定义的执行错误的重复,每个临床相关的错误类型各一次. 为了避免记录多次几乎相同的重复,有意识地将正确和不正确的处决分开而不是合并在一起。 我们以往的康复数据收集经验表明,连续的正确重复往往变得不自然地一致,而交替的正确和不正确的处决则带来了在家锻炼期间观察到的自然变化。 所有录音都手工分解为个别重复,并由监督理疗师作说明。

blocks.en: Although participants were instructed to align themselves with the prescribed viewing angles, small deviations in body orientation were intentionally preserved. Consequently, the ( 10 ∘ 10^{\circ} ) increments represent nominal rather than exact viewing angles. This variability closely reflects realistic home-rehabilitation scenarios, where patients are unlikely to position themselves with perfect accuracy relative to the camera. Preserving these naturally occurring orientation offsets therefore enables the evaluation of viewpoint robustness under practical deployment conditions.
blocks.zh: 虽然已指示与会者与规定的取景角度保持一致,但故意保留了身体定向方面的小偏差。 因此,(10 ∘ 10^{\circ})递增表示名义上而非准确的取景角度. 这种可变性紧密地反映了现实的家庭康复情景,即相对于相机,病人不太可能以完美的精确度定位自己. 因此,保持这些自然出现的方向抵消了在实际部署条件下评价观点的稳健性。

blocks.en: 3.3 Dataset Statistics
blocks.zh: 3.3 数据集统计

blocks.en: The resulting REHAB26-ViewAngles dataset comprises 3 rehabilitation exercise types performed by 5 participants under 11 nominal body orientations. For every combination of exercise, participant, and orientation, 10 repetitions were recorded, including 5 correct executions and 5 incorrect executions corresponding to predefined clinical error types. In total, the dataset contains 1,650 manually annotated exercise repetitions, evenly divided between correct and incorrect execution. Each erroneous repetition is additionally labeled with the specific type of clinical error performed.

blocks.en: Using the collected REHAB26-ViewAngles dataset, we investigate how camera placement and pose estimation strategy influence the quality of personalized rehabilitation monitoring. We consider two practical deployment scenarios: (1) typical home environments, where only a single camera is available, and (2) advanced clinical or home settings employing two uncalibrated cameras. For each scenario, our objective is to identify the optimal camera placement and the most suitable approach for obtaining reliable skeletal representations from the available RGB video stream(s).
blocks.zh: 利用收集的REHAB26-ViewAngles数据集,我们调查照相机的放置和提出估计策略如何影响个性化康复监测的质量. 我们考虑两种实际部署方案:(1) 典型的家庭环境,只有一台摄像机;(2) 先进的临床或家庭环境,使用两台未校准的摄像机。 对于每一种情景,我们的目标是确定最佳的相机位置和从现有的RGB视频流中获得可靠的骨骼表示的最适当方法。

blocks.en: This section first introduces the exercise quality assessment framework used throughout the paper. It then provides an overview of the considered single- and multi-camera approaches and formulates the research questions addressed in the experimental evaluation. Finally, it describes the investigated skeleton acquisition methods, including their implementation details.

blocks.en: The quality of exercise monitoring is strongly influenced by the accuracy and reliability of the skeletal data extracted from RGB video. For both single- and multi-camera settings, several pose acquisition strategies exist, as illustrated in Fig. 5. In a single-camera environment, the main design choices involve selecting an appropriate camera viewpoint and determining whether 2D or 3D human pose estimation (HPE) provides a more suitable representation for exercise assessment. In a multi-camera environment, we consider a practical setup with two cameras placed approximately orthogonally to each other. However, multiple strategies need be considered for combining the available views, ranging from independent 2D analysis to the reconstruction or estimation of 3D skeletal representations.
blocks.zh: 从RGB视频中提取的骨骼数据的准确性和可靠性强烈影响了锻炼监测的质量. 对于单相机和多相机两种环境,如Fig所示,有几种组合的获取策略。 5. 在单摄像头环境中,主要的设计选择包括选择适当的摄像头观点,以及确定2D或3D人类姿势估计(HPE)是否为演练评估提供了更适当的代表。 在多相机环境中,我们考虑一个实用的设置,两台相机大约正对地布置在一起. 然而,需要考虑多种战略,将现有观点结合起来,从独立的二维分析到重建或估计三维骨骼表现。

blocks.en: The objective of this study is to determine which combinations of camera placement and skeleton acquisition strategies provide the most stable and discriminative information for personalized exercise quality assessment. Specifically, we investigate the following research questions:
blocks.zh: 这项研究的目的是确定摄影机布置和骨架获取策略的哪些组合为个性化演练质量评估提供了最稳定和最歧视性的信息. 具体而言,我们调查下列研究问题:

blocks.en: RQ1: Feature-level analysis . How does camera viewpoint influence the accuracy of individual exercise features? RQ2: Exercise-level optimization . How can the optimal camera viewpoint be determined for a given rehabilitation exercise? RQ3: Orientation robustness . Given an optimal camera viewpoint, how sensitive is exercise quality assessment to small deviations in patient orientation? RQ4: Pose dimensionality . Does 2D or 3D skeletal representation provide more reliable information for exercise quality assessment? RQ5: Multi-camera fusion . What is the most suitable strategy for obtaining 3D skeletal representations when two uncalibrated cameras are available? RQ6: Multi-camera benefit . What improvement in exercise quality assessment can be achieved by using two cameras instead of one?
blocks.zh: RQ1:地物级分析. 相机视角如何影响个人运动特征的准确性? RQ2:锻炼级优化. 如何确定特定康复活动的最佳摄像头视角? RQ3:方向稳健性. 鉴于最佳镜头视角,对患者定向小偏差进行质量评估有多敏感? RQ4: Pose维度. 2D还是3D骨骼代表为锻炼质量评估提供了更可靠的信息? RQ5:多镜头聚变. 当有两台未校准的摄像头时,获得3D骨骼表现最合适的策略是什么? RQ6:多镜头收益. 使用两台相机而不是一台相机可以提高工作质量?

blocks.en: RQ1–RQ4 focus on single-camera rehabilitation monitoring and analyze how viewpoint selection and skeleton representation influence both individual movement features and overall exercise assessment. RQ5 and RQ6 address multi-camera scenarios, focusing respectively on combining information from multiple views and quantifying the practical benefit of additional camera input.

blocks.en: 4.3 Single Camera Environments
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 单相机环境

blocks.en: When only a single video stream is available, the quality of skeleton data is determined solely by the accuracy of a given human-pose-estimation (HPE) method and the camera angle. As discussed earlier, there are two types of skeleton data that HPE methods can provide: 2D coordinates, expressed in pixels within the video frame, and 3D coordinates, expressed in virtual meters. Depending on the specific HPE architecture, the 3D coordinates can be derived directly from the video, or a two-stage approach can be used, where 2D joint locations are first detected and then lifted to the 3D space.
blocks.zh: 当只有单个视频流可用时,骨架数据的质量完全由给定的人类占有估计(HPE)方法和相机角度的精确度决定. 如前所述,HPE方法可以提供两种骨架数据:2D坐标,以视频帧内的像素表示,3D坐标,以虚拟仪表表示. 根据具体的HPE架构,3D坐标可以直接从视频中衍生出来,也可以采用两阶段的方法,即首先检测到2D联合位置,然后提升到3D空间.

blocks.en: The suitability of 2D and 3D HPE for different tasks remains an open question. While 3D poses principally enable all-directional assessment of movement quality, extracting them is difficult, with depth as the main source of uncertainty. Using 2D pose estimation avoids this problem, but at the cost of observing the movement only through a single projection, where what can be seen and measured depends strongly on the camera viewpoint.
blocks.zh: 2D和3DHPE是否适合执行不同的任务仍然是一个有待解决的问题. 虽然3D主要能够对移动质量进行全方向评估,但提取这些质量是困难的,深度是不确定性的主要来源。 使用2D表示估计可以避免这个问题,但以仅通过单一投影来观察运动为代价,在那里能够看到和测量的东西在很大程度上取决于镜头视角.

blocks.en: In practice, patients often struggle to position themselves correctly, and joint occlusions are common. Such occlusions reduce both the reliability of HPE and, subsequently, that of feature extraction, making the assessment of exercise quality difficult, as apparent similarities may arise by chance rather than from accurate execution. Furthermore, different exercises exhibit distinct kinematic characteristics that favor particular viewing angles. Lateral views may better capture squat depth and knee alignment, while frontal views might optimally reveal arm abduction symmetry and shoulder positioning. This paper, therefore, addresses a critical practical deployment question: which single camera position provides the most informative view when only one camera is available, as is typically the case in home rehabilitation settings?
blocks.zh: 在实际操作中,患者往往会挣扎于正确定位,而联合隔离也很常见. 这种隐匿性既降低了高压设备的可靠性,也降低了随后的特性提取的可靠性,使得对锻炼质量的评估变得困难,因为显而易见的相似性可能是偶然产生的,而不是准确的执行。 此外,不同的演练表现出不同的运动特征,有利于特定的取景角度。 横向观点可能更好地捕捉蹲深度和膝盖排列,而正面观点可能最好地揭示手臂绑架的对称性和肩部位置。 因此,本文涉及一个关键的实际部署问题:在只有一台相机的情况下,哪台单摄像头位置能提供最翔实的视线,家庭康复环境中的典型情况就是如此?

blocks.en: Implementation. For single-camera HPE, we utilize the widely adopted MediaPipe Pose model 1 1 1 https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/pose_landmarker , which offers both 2D and 3D pose estimates. To ensure that our findings regarding optimal viewing angles are not merely artifacts of a single network architecture, we cross-validate our 2D results using YOLO26 ( Sapkota et al., 2025 ) . To evaluate these pose estimates, we define the extracted features for individual coordinate spaces as follows: for 2D data, we compute the feature angles directly in the camera’s field of view; for 3D data, we first normalize each pose so that the person’s hips are aligned with the x x -axis, and then measure the feature angles in either the x ​ y xy , y ​ z yz , or x ​ z xz plane, depending on the specific feature type.
blocks.zh: 执行。 对于单摄像头HPE,我们使用被广泛采用的MediaPipe Pose模式11 1 https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/pose_landmarker,该模式提供2D和3D两种形式估计。 我们使用YOLO26(Sapkota等人,2025年)交叉验证我们的2D结果, 为了评估这些布局估计,我们定义单个坐标空格的提取特征如下: 对于2D数据,我们直接计算相机视野中的特征角;对于3D数据,我们首先使每个布局正常化,以便人物的臀部与xx -轴对齐,然后测量xy xy,y yz,或x z xz平面中的特征角,视具体特征类型而定.

blocks.en: 4.4 Multiple Camera Environments
blocks.zh: 4.4 多相机环境

blocks.en: As depicted in Fig. 5 , we identified 4 approaches to analyzing human motion recorded by 2 synchronized cameras. In the first method, a 2D skeleton pose is extracted from each stream, and individual features are computed from the more suitable view. The other three options utilize different techniques to create a more precise 3D skeleton pose.
blocks.zh: 如图5所示,我们确定了分析由两台同步摄像机记录的人类运动的4个方法。 在第一种方法中,从每条溪流中提取一个2D骨架姿势,从更合适的角度计算个别特征. 其他三种选择利用不同的技术来创造更精确的3D骨架姿势.

blocks.en: Orthogonal 2D HPE. 2D HPE is known to provide sufficiently precise estimates of joint coordinates in the camera view plane. With two cameras, we can capture orthogonal views of the exercising person so that each exercise feature is clearly visible in at least one view. For each feature, it is determined in advance which view should be considered.
blocks.zh: 矫形2D HPE. 据了解,2D HPE对相机视平面中的联合坐标提供了足够精确的估计. 有了两个摄像头,我们可以捕捉锻炼者正交视线,这样,每个运动特征至少在一个视线上都清晰可见. 对于每个特点,应事先确定应考虑何种意见。

blocks.en: Implementation. We utilize the MediaPipe Pose model for all 2D pose extractions in this section.
blocks.zh: 执行。 我们使用MediaPipe Pose模型 用于本节所有2D图案提取。

blocks.en:
Arithmetic Triangulation. Geometric triangulation is a standard approach for reconstructing 3D joint positions by intersecting back-projected rays from multiple 2D camera views ( Hartley and Sturm, 1997 ) .
This approach requires explicit camera calibration. Because our recording setup was highly controlled, using identical, time-synchronized cameras placed at exact 45 ∘ 45^{\circ} intervals, we derived the necessary calibration parameters directly from the known physical geometry. In practice, minor 2D tracking noise prevents perfect ray intersections, so the final 3D coordinate is estimated by finding the optimal geometric fit.
blocks.zh:
算术三角形. 几何三角形是通过从多个2D相机视图中交叉反射射线来重建3D联合位置的标准方法(Hartley and Sturm,1997 ).
这种方法需要明确的相机校准. 因为我们的录制设置高度控制, 使用相同的,时间同步的相机 放置在精确的45~~45~circ}间隔, 我们直接从已知的物理几何学中得出了必要的校准参数。 在实际操作中,小的2D跟踪噪声会阻止完美的射线交叉,所以最终的3D坐标是通过找到最佳几何配位来估计的.

blocks.en: Implementation. We utilize the OpenCV library ( Bradski, 2000 ) , which follows the formulation to compute the Direct Linear Transform (DLT) ( Hartley and Zisserman, 2004 ) .
blocks.zh: 执行。 我们利用OpenCV库(布拉德斯基,2000年),该库按照配方计算直线变换(DLT)(Hartley和Zisserman,2004年)。

blocks.en: Weighted Multi-View Fusion. Another option is to extract a 3D pose estimate from each camera and combine these estimates by weighted averaging. Many HPE methods, including MediaPipe, provide confidence scores for each estimated joint position, which can be used as the weight. The underlying assumption is that joints observed from a more obstructed viewpoint receive lower visibility scores and should contribute less to the final estimate.
blocks.zh: 重量型多维融合. 另一种办法是从每台相机中提取一个3D姿势估计,并按加权平均值将这些估计合并. 包括MediaPipe在内的许多HPE方法为每个估计的关节位置提供信心分数,可以用作权重. 基本假设是,从较受阻碍的观点来看,所观察到的关节的能见度分数较低,应较少有助于最后估计。

blocks.en: Multi-View HPE. We adopt the Ray-Based Universal Multi-view Pose Lifter (RUMPL) ( Ghasemzadeh et al., 2026 ) as our learning-based fusion backbone. RUMPL’s ray-based transformer architecture offers a robust alternative to geometric fusion, capable of resolving depth ambiguities and handling severe occlusions even in sparse, two-camera configurations. Its ability to learn human kinematics from synthetic data provides a strong, data-efficient baseline for evaluating clinical movements, particularly when real-world multi-view data are limited.
blocks.zh: 多维HPE. 我们采用以雷为主的多视多视立体(RUMPL)(Ghasemzadeh等人,2026年)作为我们以学习为基础的聚变骨干。 RUMPL的射线式变压器结构为几何聚变提供了强有力的替代品,能够解决深度模糊问题,并处理严重的隐蔽性,即使是在稀少的两相机配置中。 其从合成数据中学习人类动能的能力为评价临床运动提供了一个强大,数据效率高的基线,特别是在现实世界多景数据有限的情况下.

blocks.en: Implementation. To ensure comparability with our monocular pipelines, we adapted RUMPL to consume 2D joint detections from MediaPipe. Because MediaPipe’s native 25-keypoint set does not fully align with the AMASS ground-truth annotations, we restricted the model to predict the 16 joints that have direct correspondences in the existing pipeline, leaving RUMPL’s core ray-fusion transformer unchanged. For training, we followed the original RUMPL pipeline: synthetic AMASS ( Mahmood et al., 2019 ) poses are rendered from randomized camera positions and fed through the same multi-view ray-triangulation procedure to produce training tokens. At inference, MediaPipe detections from our calibrated cameras are projected into this same ray space using the known camera calibration matrices of our experimental setup.
blocks.zh: 执行。 为了确保与我们单光管的可比性,我们改造了RUMPL,以消耗MediaPipe的2D联合检测. 因为MediaPipe的原生的25个关键点集与AMASS的地面真实说明并不完全一致,所以我们限制模型来预测现有管道中有直接通信的16个关节,使得RUMPL的核心射线聚变压器保持不变. 为了训练,我们沿用了最初的RUMPL输油管:合成AMASS(Mahmood等人,2019年)的姿势由随机照相机姿势提供,并通过同样的多视线射线三角化程序喂养,以产生训练符. 推断一下,MediaPipe从我们校准的摄像头的探测器 被投射到同一个射线空间 利用我们实验设置的已知的相机校准矩阵

blocks.en: 5 Experimental Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5 实验评价.

blocks.en: The objective of the experimental evaluation is to determine which camera viewpoints and pose representations most reliably capture exercise-specific movement features and allow us to detect incorrectly performed repetitions. Towards this end, we systematically evaluate different viewing angles and pose estimation methods.
blocks.zh: 实验评价的目的是确定哪些镜头视角和呈现出最可靠的捕捉运动特定运动特征,并使我们能够检测不正确的重复。 为此,我们系统地评估不同的视角,并提出估算方法。

blocks.en: 5.1 Methodology
blocks.zh: 5.1 方法

blocks.en: The basic unit of exercise quality assessment is the exercise sequence S S . Let us recall that each sequence in the REHAB26-ViewAngles dataset is composed of 5 correctly performed and 5 intentionally erroneous exercise repetitions. The objective of quality assessment is to assign a low error score to correct repetitions and a high error score to incorrect ones. The ability to distinguish between correct and incorrect execution is quantified by the separability Ψ \Psi introduced in Section 4.1 . The score is computed for each incorrect repetition and takes values in the interval [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] , where values close to 1 indicate good separation between correct and incorrect execution.
blocks.zh: 锻炼质量评估的基本单位是锻炼序列S S. 让我们回顾,REHAB26-ViewAngles数据集中的每个序列都由5个正确操作和5个故意错误练习重复组成。 质量评估的目标是分配一个低差错分以纠正重复,高差错分以纠正错误. 第4.1节中引入的可分离性============= 每次不正确的重复都计算得分,并在[− 1, 1] [-1, 1] 的间隔中取值,其中接近 1 的数值表示正确与不正确执行之间的良好区分.

blocks.en: For every exercise sequence, a personalized exercise model is first constructed from the five correct repetitions, as described in Section 4.1 . This model is subsequently compared with each incorrect repetition in the sequence. Let us recall that each incorrect repetition corresponds to a predefined clinical error and is associated with one or more features designed to detect that particular error. In experiments that focus on individual features, we therefore evaluate Ψ k ​ ( R e ​ r ​ r k , M S , R ​ e ​ p ​ s O ​ K S ) \Psi^{k}(R^{k}_{err},M^{S},Reps^{S}_{OK}) , where R e ​ r ​ r k R^{k}_{err} is the erroneous repetition with error on feature F k F_{k} . In experiments evaluating the overall suitability of a camera configuration for a given exercise, all erroneous repetitions within the sequence are considered, and the overall separability Ψ \Psi is computed for each repetition across all relevant features. The relevant features were identified using ground-truth annotations specifying the error type for each repetition.
blocks.zh: 如第4.1节所述,对于每一个锻炼序列,首先从五次正确的重复中构建一个个性化锻炼模型。 这个模型随后与序列中每次错误的重复作比较. 让我们回顾,每次错误的重复都与预先定义的临床错误相对应,并且与旨在检测该特定错误的一个或多个特征有关。 因此,在侧重于个别特征的实验中,我们评价 Ψ k (R e r k, M S, R e p s O K S ) (R^{k}_{err), R e r k r r r r r r r r r r r r r r r r r r r r r r r] 错误地重复了 F k F q k 的功能。 在评估照相机配置整体适合特定练习的实验中,会考虑序列中的所有错误重复,并且计算出在所有相关特性中每次重复的总体可分离性。 利用地面真实说明确定了相关特征,具体说明每次重复的错误类型。

blocks.en: The separability score Ψ \Psi is computed independently for every exercise sequence and every considered skeleton acquisition method. Each sequence was recorded simultaneously by three cameras, providing three single-camera viewpoints. In addition, one orthogonal two-camera configuration, comprising Cam1 and Cam3, is considered for multi-camera experiments. To evaluate a particular viewpoint, the corresponding separability scores are averaged over all exercise sequences recorded from that viewpoint.
blocks.zh: 分离度分 \\ Psi 是对每个运动序列和每个考虑的骨架获取方法独立计算的 。 每个序列由三台相机同步录制,提供了三台单相机视角. 此外,一个正交双相机配置,包括Cam1和Cam3,被考虑用于多相机实验. 为了评价某一特定观点,相应的可分离性分数平均为从该观点记录的所有练习序列。

blocks.en: For single-camera experiments, all viewing angles available in the REHAB26-ViewAngles dataset are evaluated, spanning the interval from − 90 ∘ -90^{\circ} to 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} . As defined in Section 3.2 , 0 ∘ 0^{\circ} denotes a frontal view, while positive and negative angles correspond to viewpoints on the participant’s right- and left-hand sides, respectively. For the orthogonal two-camera configuration, the viewing angle is specified with respect to Cam1, yielding a range from − 90 ∘ -90^{\circ} to 0 ∘ 0^{\circ} (see Fig. 2 ).
5.2 Single Camera Environments
blocks.zh: 5.2 单相机环境

blocks.en: A comprehensive set of experiments over the REHAB26-ViewAngles dataset allows us to address all research questions we set out to investigate. The first three questions for single-camera settings analyze effective camera angles and sensitivity to viewpoint changes using 2D skeleton data, while the forth question discusses the impact of using 3D pose estimates instead of 2D.
blocks.zh: 一套关于REHAB26-ViewAngles数据集的全面实验,使我们能够解决我们开始调查的所有研究问题。 单相机设置的前三个问题分析有效的相机角度和对使用2D骨架数据查看变化的敏感度,而前一个问题则讨论使用3D而不是2D来提出估计的影响.

blocks.en: RQ1: Feature-level analysis. To understand the effect of camera angles on the visibility of individual features, we utilize heatmaps presented in Fig. 6 (first row), which visualize feature separability scores ( Ψ k \Psi^{k} ) across viewing angles. The results clearly demonstrate that the optimal viewpoint is feature-dependent. For example, shoulder elevation (F2) is most reliably assessed from a frontal view ( 0 ∘ 0^{\circ} ), whereas the knee pass toes features (F11, F12) require an oblique or lateral view, with the highest separability typically achieved at angles of 45 ∘ 45^{\circ} or greater. Furthermore, for Exercises 1 and 2, positive viewing angles generally outperform negative ones because the movements are performed with the right arm, making the active limb more visible from the participant’s right-hand side.
blocks.zh: RQ1:地物级分析. 为了了解相机角度对单个特征可见度的影响,我们利用图6(第一行)中呈现的热图,可视化地标的可分性分数( k\Psi^{k})跨视角. 结果清楚地表明,最佳观点取决于具体情况。 例如,肩高(F2)最可靠地从前视(0∘0^{\circ})评估,而膝盖通过脚趾特征(F11,F12)则需要斜视或平视,通常在45∘45^{\circ}或更高角度上达到最高的分隔. 此外,对于第1和第2号演习,正视角度一般比负视角度要好,因为运动是用右臂进行的,从而使活动四肢从参与者的右侧更明显。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Illustration of feature separability scores ( Ψ k \Psi^{k} ) for Exercises 1, 2, and 3 at different viewpoint angles. In each heatmap, rows correspond to camera angles and columns to individual features. The uppermost heatmaps present features computed from 2D poses. The second row of heatmaps shows features computed from 3D poses. In the last row, rotation heatmaps visualize how deviations from the optimal viewing angle affect the separability scores. Darker green indicates higher separability scores, while dark red corresponds to situations where correct and incorrect repetitions are indistinguishable.
blocks.zh: 图6:以不同角度对练习1、2和3的特征分离分数进行说明(XQ k\Psi^{k}). 在每个热图中,行对应相机角度,列对应单个特征. 最上面的热图呈现出从2D姿势计算出来的特性. 第二行热图显示从3D姿势计算出来的特性. 在最后一行中,旋转热映射可以直观地看到偏离最佳取景角度如何影响可分离性分数. 更深的绿色表示较高的可分性分数,而深红色则对应的是正确和不正确的重复无法分辨的情况.

blocks.en: Although a few isolated outliers can be observed (e.g., a performance peak of F3 at − 90 ∘ -90^{\circ} ), these are likely caused by incidental postural changes rather than the camera viewpoint itself. More importantly, the heatmaps show that most features exhibit a relatively broad range of viewing angles with comparable separability scores. Consequently, reliable feature extraction does not require precise patient positioning, an observation that is further investigated in RQ3.
blocks.zh: 虽然可以观察到一些孤立的外围点(例如,在−90 ∘-90^{\circ}的性能峰值为F3),但这些可能是偶然的姿势变化引起的,而不是相机视角本身. 更重要的是,热图显示,大多数特征显示的视角范围相对较广,具有可比较的分隔分数. 因此,可靠的特征提取不需要精确的病人定位,在RQ3中进一步调查这一观察.

blocks.en: Beyond spatial considerations, the heatmaps also reveal an important temporal aspect of exercise quality assessment. Features such as insufficient arm abduction (F5) appear comparatively weak, with lower separability scores across all viewing angles than, for example, the knee pass toes features (F11, F12). This, however, does not necessarily indicate that the feature itself is less informative. Rather, the corresponding movement error occurs only briefly near the peak of the repetition, so although the feature correctly captures the error at that instant, its average error over the entire repetition remains relatively low. In contrast, the knee pass toes error persists throughout a larger portion of the squat movement, producing a stronger and more stable separation between correct and incorrect executions. This observation suggests that feature separability is influenced not only by the severity of the detected error but also by its temporal persistence. Developing feature aggregation strategies that jointly account for both factors represents an interesting direction for future research.
blocks.zh: 除空间考虑外,热图还揭示了锻炼质量评估的一个重要时间方面。 臂部绑架不足(F5)等特征显得相对薄弱,在所有视角上的分数低于膝盖传动脚趾特征(F11,F12)等. 然而,这并不一定表明该特征本身信息较少。 相反,相应的运动误差只短暂地发生在重复的峰值附近,因此虽然该特性在那一瞬间正确捕捉到错误,但其整个重复的平均误差仍然相对较低. 与此相反,膝盖脚趾误差在整个蹲蹲运动中持续存在,造成更有力和更稳定的正确与不正确的处决分离。 这一意见表明,特征分离不仅受到所发现错误的严重程度的影响,而且还受到其持续时间的影响。 制定共同考虑到这两个因素的特征汇总战略,是今后研究的一个令人感兴趣的方向。

blocks.en: RQ2: Exercise-level optimization. To identify the most effective camera placement for each exercise, we evaluated the overall separability Ψ \Psi for each camera angle (Table 3 ). blocks.en:
As expected, no single “universal” best viewpoint exists. The optimal angle is determined by the combination of discriminative features within each exercise. It is not strongly correlated with the primary movement direction: although Exercise 1 is performed mainly in the frontal plane and Exercise 2 in the lateral plane, their optimal viewpoints are nearly identical. Instead, the decisive factor is the direction of the most frequent execution errors. For Exercises 1 and 2, most errors occur in the frontal plane and are better captured from lower viewing angles, whereas Exercise 3 involves substantial errors in both frontal and lateral planes, making a half-profile view more suitable.
Importantly, an optimally placed 2D camera increases the separability by 16.9 % relative to the commonly used 0 ∘ 0^{\circ} frontal view. Here, relative improvements are reported as percentage gains over the baseline separability score within the positive region, calculated as Ψ new − Ψ base Ψ base × 100 % \frac{\Psi_{\text{new}}-\Psi_{\text{base}}}{\Psi_{\text{base}}}\times 100\,\% . This highlights that camera placement is a decisive factor for maximizing discriminative performance in monocular 2D pose-based assessment.

blocks.en: RQ4: Pose dimensionality. The comparison between 2D and 3D skeletal representations is shown in the second row of Fig. 6 , with overall separability scores reported in Table 3 . The results indicate only minor differences in stability and discriminative power for Exercises 1 and 2, but a pronounced difference for Exercise 3, where the 2D representations provide clearly better separability. This can likely be attributed to the nature of Exercise 3, which involves larger full-body movements; inaccurate depth estimates in such cases distort the overall pose representation. Overall, the 2D representation yields more consistent and more clearly separable results, aligning with previous findings that suggest greater stability of 2D pose features ( Sun et al., 2025 ) . For Exercises 1 and 3, the 3D representation performs noticeably worse than its 2D counterpart, indicating that the additional depth dimension introduces pose estimation error that outweighs its benefits. Exercise 2 shows slightly better results in 3D, likely due to its stronger reliance on depth-related motion, though the differences remain subtle. When considered together with the findings from RQ3, the practical usability of 3D skeleton data is further reduced, as changes in camera angle diminish feature differences even more. Overall, despite their intuitive appeal, 3D representations appear less robust than 2D skeleton data for exercise-quality assessment in the evaluated setting. This structural divergence and data degradation are visually highlighted in Fig. 7 , where the 3D extraction signals display significant baseline noise compared to the stable 2D multi-angle tracking.

blocks.en: 5.3 Multiple Camera Environments
blocks.zh: 5.3 多相机环境

blocks.en: In this section, we address the remaining two research questions that focus on the combination of inputs from two camera streams.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们讨论剩下的两个研究问题,侧重于两个相机流的投入的组合。

blocks.en: RQ5: Multi-camera fusion. To find out which multi-camera approach can provide the most precise 3D poses, three extraction strategies were evaluated using data from Cam1 and Cam3: 3D triangulation, 3D merging, and RUMPL, a state-of-the-art transformer-based multi-view approach. The results in Table 3 demonstrate that the triangulation-based approach produces the most stable 3D representations and achieves the highest overall improvement among the evaluated methods. By exploiting geometric consistency across views, triangulation reduces depth-related noise and yields more reliable joint estimates.
blocks.zh: RQ5:多镜头聚变. 为了找出哪一种多相机方法可以提供最精确的3D外观,利用Cam1和Cam3的数据评价了三种提取策略:3D三角形,3D合并,以及RUMPL,一种最先进的基于变压器的多视图方法. 表3的结果表明,基于三角的方法产生最稳定的立体表示,并在被评价方法中实现最高的整体改进。 通过利用各种观点的几何一致性,三角测量会减少与深度有关的噪音,产生更可靠的联合估计.

blocks.en: In contrast, the weighted 3D merging and RUMPL methods show inconsistent performance. The merging strategy remains sensitive to inaccuracies in individual depth estimates, often assigning high confidence to noisy data, while the RUMPL approach, though powerful, is built for data-rich environments and struggles with the depth ambiguity inherent in sparse, two-camera setups. We further observe that performance is highly sensitive to camera placement. The best results occur when both cameras capture the subject from a side-on perspective, at roughly − 40 ∘ -40^{\circ} and 50 ∘ 50^{\circ} . This orientation offers an optimal trade-off, avoiding the self-occlusions typical of frontal or lateral views while maximizing the geometric information available to the system.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,加权3D合并和RUMPL方法显示性能不一致. 合并战略对单个深度估计中的不准确性仍然很敏感,往往给吵闹的数据以很高的信心,而RUMPL方法虽然很有力,但是为了数据丰富的环境而建立起来的,与稀疏的两相机设置所固有的深度模糊性作斗争。 我们进一步注意到,性能对摄像机的放置高度敏感。 最佳结果发生在两个摄像头从侧面角度捕捉到对象时, 这种取向提供了最佳的取舍,避免了正面或横向观点典型的自我包容,同时使系统可获得的几何信息最大化.

blocks.en:
RQ6: Multi-camera benefit. The final research question focuses on the benefits of multi-camera exercise monitoring, as compared to single-camera environments. In Table 3 , we can observe that the only multi-camera approach that consistently meets or outperforms single-camera 2D HPE is the orthogonal combination of two 2D views. The increase of separability over the single camera 2D MPP setup is 0 % for Exercise 1, 26.6 % for Exercise 2, and 12.7 % for Exercise 3. Among the 3D pose estimation methods, the triangulation is the most promising, but it is not reliable for all exercise types – the respective separability gains are 1.5 %, 23.3 %, and -1.8 %.
Overall, although multi-view approaches can provide moderate performance gains, their practical deployment is more demanding, requiring more space, specialized calibration, and hardware-level camera synchronization that is virtually impossible to achieve with standard smartphones in unconstrained home environments. In contrast, single-view 2D methods are simpler and more flexible, and their fast implementations for mobile devices are already available. Therefore, we recommend single-camera 2D pose estimation as the primary approach for monitoring rehabilitation exercises.
blocks.zh:
RQ6:多镜头收益. 最后的研究问题侧重于与单镜头环境相比多镜头演练监测的好处. 在表3中,我们可以观察到,唯一一贯满足或超过单相机2D HPE的多相机方法是两个2D观点的正交结合. 单相机2D MPP设置的可分离性提高,第1演练为0%,第2演练为26.6%,第3演练为12.7%. 在3D配置估计方法中,三角定位是最有希望的,但对于所有锻炼类型来说并不可靠 — — 相应的分离收益是1.5%,23.3%和 -1.8 %.
总体而言,虽然多视角方法可以提供适度的性能收益,但其实际部署要求更高,需要更多的空间,专门的校准,以及硬件级别的相机同步,在不受约束的家庭环境中,用标准智能手机几乎不可能实现. 相比之下,单景2D方法更简单更灵活,它们对于移动设备的快速实施已经存在. 因此,我们建议采用单摄像头2D作为监测康复工作的主要方法。

blocks.en: 5.4 Computational Complexity and Real-Time Viability
blocks.zh: 5.4 计算的复杂性和实时可行性

blocks.en: To be viable for home rehabilitation, assessment systems must run reliably on consumer smartphones. Standard 2D pose estimation models are well-suited for this constraint: MediaPipe Full requires approximately 10 10 M parameters ( ≈ 2 \approx 2 GFLOPs), and YOLO26 uses roughly 3.6 3.6 M parameters ( ≈ 10 \approx 10 GFLOPs). In contrast, Multi-View Human Pose Estimation (MV-HPE) pipelines like RUMPL did not improve skeleton data quality. While RUMPL’s compact 3D lifting architecture ( ≈ 12 \approx 12 M parameters, ≈ 0.33 \approx 0.33 GFLOPs) could theoretically run on a smartphone, requiring simultaneous 2D feature extraction across multiple video feeds quickly exceeds hardware limits. Among multi-camera setups, the orthogonal 2D approach is the most promising, delivering the highest assessment quality. While running lightweight 2D extraction independently across two smartphones is computationally well within mobile hardware capabilities, the primary deployment challenge remains the temporal synchronization of the video streams to enable joint feature evaluation.
blocks.zh: 为了便于家庭康复,评估系统必须可靠地运行在消费智能手机上。 标准2D平面模型非常适合这一制约因素: MediaPipe Full需要大约10个10 M参数(≈ 2\约2 GFLOPs),YOLO26使用大约3.6 3.6 M参数(≈ 10\约10 GFLOPs). 相比之下,像RUMPL这样的多维人类松脂估计(MV-HPE)管道并没有提高骨架数据质量. 虽然RUMPL的紧凑的3D提升架构(QQ 12 \ 大约 12 M参数,QQ 0.33\大约 0.33 GFLOPs)在理论上可以在智能手机上运行,但需要跨越多个视频素材的同步2D特性提取迅速超过硬件限制. 在多镜头设定中,正交2D方法是最有前途的,提供最高的评价质量. 虽然在两部智能手机上独立运行轻量级2D提取在移动硬件能力范围内计算良好,但首要的部署挑战仍然是视频流的时间同步,以便能够进行联合特性评价.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 6. 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we investigate an often overlooked aspect of automatic rehabilitation monitoring: the impact of camera viewpoint on exercise assessment. We introduce the REHAB26-ViewAngles dataset and a dedicated methodology to quantify the separability of exercise errors. Contrary to common practice, which relies on frontal or side views, we find that slight lateral and half-profile perspectives are optimal for three basic exercise types, improving separability by 16.9 % compared to the commonly used 0 ∘ 0^{\circ} frontal view. We further evaluate robustness under realistic conditions with inconsistent camera placement, observing a tolerance of approximately 10 ∘ 10^{\circ} ; larger deviations substantially reduce assessment accuracy. These findings emphasize the need to guide patients to appropriate camera positions in vision-based rehabilitation systems.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们调查了自动康复监测中经常被忽视的一个方面:镜头观点对锻炼评估的影响。 我们引入了REHAB26-ViewAngles数据集和一个专门的方法来量化运动错误的分离性. 与依赖正面或侧面观点的常见做法相反,我们发现微小的平面和半面视角对三种基本运动类型来说是最佳的,与常用的0 ∘ 0 ^{\ 0^{\ ^{\ rc } }  front  front  front al al  view  view  view  view  view  view  view 我们进一步评估在现实条件下的稳健性,相机布置不一致,观测到的耐力大约为10××××××××××××××(10××××××××××);较大的偏差大大降低了评估的准确性。 这些调查结果强调,需要引导患者在基于视力的康复系统中获得适当的摄像机位置。

blocks.en: We also analyzed suitable data acquisition strategies for feature extraction in multi-camera environments. Our experiments indicate that 2D pose estimation currently provides more accurate quality assessment than 3D methods, leading to better exercise separability (on average 9.2 %). To improve 3D reconstruction, we proposed four multi-camera fusion strategies. Among them, the orthogonal approach achieved the greatest improvement, increasing performance by about 13.1 % over the best single-camera setup, while triangulation provided a more modest gain of approximately 7.6 %. Furthermore, the orthogonal method is highly advantageous for real-world deployment, as it is computationally lightweight, requires no additional model training, and allows users to simply place two available cameras in the environment to intuitively combine their views. With this approach, the only remaining practical challenge is ensuring robust temporal synchronization between the devices. In contrast, the merged strategy showed greater sensitivity to underlying inaccuracies in 3D pose estimation, while the MV-HPE approach struggled with joint occlusions, as reliably resolving them typically demands denser camera arrays (e.g., four or more viewpoints).
blocks.zh: 我们还分析了在多摄像机环境中提取地物的适当数据采集战略。 我们的实验表明,2D提出估计目前提供的质量评估比3D方法更准确,从而可以更好地进行分离(平均为9.2%)。 为了改善立体重建,我们提出了四个多镜头聚变战略. 其中,正交方法取得了最大的改进,比最佳单相机设置提高了约13.1%的性能,而三角化则提供了约7.6%的更微小的收益. 此外,正交方法对于现实世界的部署非常有利,因为它在计算上轻量级,不需要额外的模型训练,并且允许用户简单地在环境中放置两台可用的相机来直观地结合他们的观点. 采用这一方法,剩下的唯一实际挑战是确保各装置之间强有力的时间同步。 与此相反,合并战略对3D中的基本不准确性作出估计的敏感度较高,而MV-HPE方法则与联合封存相冲突,因为可靠地解决这些问题通常需要更密集的相机阵列(例如四个或四个以上的观点)。

blocks.en: Ultimately, this study provides both methodological and practical contributions to rehabilitation research. Our findings offer actionable guidance for the real-world development of vision-based rehabilitation systems. Future work will extend the feature separability scoring framework to more explicitly account for the influence of error duration. Specifically, we aim to explore dynamic temporal weighting to ensure that errors at the critical apex of a movement are prioritized over minor fluctuations during resting phases.
blocks.zh: 归根结底,这项研究为康复研究提供了方法和实践上的贡献。 我们的调查结果为现实世界发展基于愿景的康复系统提供了可操作的指导。 今后的工作将扩大特征分离评分框架,更明确地说明错误持续时间的影响。 具体地说,我们的目标是探索动态时间权重,以确保在休息阶段,运动顶端的错误优先于轻微波动。
